## The brief

The organisers' request, as the abstract.

::: {.abstract}
- A research exchange the day after the workshop, 15 September, hosted by
  Pieter Libin's AI Lab at VUB.
- Selected members of the VUB AI group and the UHasselt and UAntwerp
  infectious disease modelling group share their work.
- I talk about my background, research group, and current work.
- Roughly half a day in total.
:::

- [Infectious disease modelling in the age of AI](../keynote/index.qmd).
